OpenOSINT is an open-source OSINT agent for investigators and security researchers: 21 public-source tools behind a natural-language interface, with an MCP server. 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 Run it yourself: uvx openosint web (one command, no keys) 
 No terminal? Use OpenOSINT Cloud in your browser, first check free

Docs · Claude Code plugin · MCP server

 

 Quickstart

Needs uv . No API keys for these commands.

 

 

Real output, trimmed and re-wrapped. More commands: CLI reference · install guide.

 What you can do

Moved to Quickstart above and the CLI reference.

 Tools

What it can look up. Per-tool docs: openosint.tech/tools. Only passive tools are on by default.

 Tool What it finds Key needed 
 --- --- --- 
 search dns DNS records, SPF, DMARC No 
 search rdap Registrar, dates, name servers (RDAP) No 
 search whois WHOIS registration data No 
 search ip Hostname, ASN, city for an IP Optional 
 search ip2location Geolocation, ISP, proxy/VPN/Tor flags (sponsored) Yes 
 search gdelt geo Geolocated news mentions (GDELT) No 
 generate dorks Search-dork URLs for a target No 
 search paste Paste-site mentions No 
 search github Repos, code and users Optional 
 search breach Breaches for an email (HaveIBeenPwned) Yes 
 search shodan Open ports and banners Yes 
 search censys Hosts and certificates Yes 
 search virustotal URL, domain and IP reputation Yes 
 search abuseipdb IP abuse reports Yes 
 search dorks live Live dork results via Bright Data SERP API¹ Yes 
 search footprint Web footprint via Bright Data SERP API¹ Yes 
 scrape url Page content via Bright Data Web Unlocker¹ (touches target) Yes 
 search username Username across platforms (sherlock; noisy) No 
 search email Accounts tied to an email (holehe; noisy) No 
 search domain Subdomains (sublist3r; noisy) No 
 search phone Carrier and country (phoneinfoga; unverified) No 

Sherlock, holehe, sublist3r and phoneinfoga run as local binaries you install yourself. Setting up the Bright Data tools: Using OpenOSINT with Bright Data.

 Why OpenOSINT

Tools run as real Python code and every finding cites the call that produced it. Compared with SpiderFoot, OpenOSINT has far fewer modules and is built to be driven by an agent. See the comparison.

 Passive by default

Agents and MCP clients are only offered tools that query third-party sources or compute locally. Anything that touches the target or sends many requests from your IP is off until you opt in ( --allow-active ) and is not listed in an MCP client's tools/list . Passive is not private: every service you query sees the query. Details: Safety.

 Use it from Claude Code or any MCP client

 

 

 

Other clients: MCP docs · Agent Skill.

 Go deeper

- Web UI: openosint web , streaming chat, a news globe and a graph view. Docs
- REPL: openosint with no arguments. CLI reference
- MCP server: uvx --from openosint openosint-mcp . Client configs

 Web UI + globe

An agent investigation lands as a point on a 3D globe; click it to pivot. Docs

 Entity graph

A FollowTheMoney graph with statement-level provenance and a review queue for same as candidates. Docs

 External exposure report (beta)

 openosint exposure example.com grades email authentication, TLS, registration and security headers A to F. Docs

 Installation

 pip install openosint or uvx openosint web . Python 3.10+. Install guide

 MCP Server

Works in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and any MCP client. Client configs

 Configuration

Keys go in the web UI Settings, /.openosint/config.env or the environment. All variables · CLI reference

 Docker

 docker compose up --build , then open . Docker notes

 OpenOSINT Cloud

The same engine as a hosted chat for a domain, an IP address or a company, with a source on every claim. First check free, no account. Hosted REST and MCP API by request: commercial@openosint.tech.

 Sponsors

 

 Featured Integrations

 

 IP2Location.io — powers search ip2location · Integration guide

 Enhanced IP geolocation, ISP, VPN/Proxy/Tor, and datacenter detection

 

 TestMu AI 

 TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) is an AI-native testing cloud platform built for modern engineering teams. It covers everything from autonomous test creation and fast execution to testing AI agents, chatbots and voice assistants.

 Open: Breach / Compromised-Credential Data · Email / Identity Lookup · Residential Proxies — see SPONSORSHIP.md. 

 

Sponsor on Open Collective · tiers in SPONSORSHIP.md · commercial license and support: COMMERCIAL.md.

 Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome. See CONTRIBUTING.md. Maintainer: Tommaso Bertocchi · @openosint oss. Contributors: @consocio ( 6).

 Legal Disclaimer

For authorized security research and educational use only. Only investigate targets you own or are permitted to assess. Passive does not mean anonymous. Full text: DISCLAIMER.md.

MIT. See LICENSE.

Needs uv. No API keys for these commands.

# Local web app with chat, graph and globe
uvx openosint web

# Or one direct check, no AI involved
uvx openosint exposure example.com

Grade: B  Score: 88/100
Checks: email OK, registration OK (passive)
        tls OK, http_headers OK (these touch the target)
  [LOW] DMARC has no aggregate report address (dmarc_no_rua)
  [LOW] Strict-Transport-Security header missing (hsts_missing)
